summary: Technical incident run on a real, reproducible finding in the built Linux package: vulnerable desktop libraries without a Ubuntu 22.04 fix (libXi, libXrender, expat, GIO, cairo, pixman, gdk-pixbuf, pcre2, ncurses) were bundled because PyInstaller collected Qt's GTK3 platform theme. Detected by the package audit, rejected as 'threat model only' by the independent reviewer, contained by removing the libraries, verified on the rebuilt package by a CI gate that reproduces the finding on any regression.
